name: LLM-written SVG
description: A language model emits SVG source directly from item title/description (e.g. via hosted or in-browser LLM).

restrictions: Licence of output depends on provider terms; sanitise SVG (scripts, foreignObject, external refs) before use
license.notes: Technique, not a package. Needs SVG sanitiser (e.g. DOMPurify, MIT/Apache) and moderation.

cost.notes: Cost per call depends on model; cache per item.

verdictReason: Cheap, resolution-independent semantic images; needs strict sanitising and caching, plus a placeholder while waiting.
